output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    # The marked 2-by-2 diagonal acts as a three-cell-wide diagonal brush.
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c,v) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    col=next((v for r,c,v in pts if v!=2), 8)
    # diagonal displacement of the marked diagonal object
    ds=[c-r for r,c,v in pts if v==col]
    d=round(sum(ds)/len(ds)) if ds else 0
    lo=d-1
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if lo <= c-r <= lo+2: out[r][c]=col
    return out"}
